The '''X3-13''', also known as the '''tactical infiltration pod''', was a model of short-distance [[hyperdrive pod]] manufactured by [[Arakyd Industries]] and used by the [[Galactic Empire]] for short-distance [[transport]]ation and [[Scout|reconnaissance]]. Due to its role, it sacrificed maneuverability and weaponry for advanced communications equipment, including a long-range [[transmitter]] and encryption abilities. The pods were designed to look like normal [[escape pod]]s in order to aid in infiltration. One such pod was used by the [[E-XD-series infiltrator droid]] [[EXD-9]] to travel to [[Atollon]] to search for the [[Phoenix Cell]]'s [[Chopper Base|base]].

==Characteristics==
The X3-13, or tactical infiltration pod, was a class of [[hyperdrive pod]] manufactured by [[Arakyd Industries]] and utilized by the [[Galactic Empire]]. It could achieve speeds of 750 [[Kilometer per hour|kilometers per hour]], was 11.7 [[meter]]s in length, and was equipped with a Class 0.5 [[hyperdrive]].<ref name="Starfighters" />

The X3-13 forfeited maneuverability and weaponry for advanced communications equipment, including a long-range [[transmitter]] at the bow of the pod and encryption abilities.<ref name="Tactical Infiltration Pod" /> It was equipped with four landing thrusters to allow for a quiet approach.<ref name="Starfighters" />

==History==
During [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn's]] [[Lothal campaign]] against [[Phoenix Cell]], X3-13s were utilized to search for the hidden rebel base, [[Chopper Base]]. One was used by [[EXD-9]], an [[E-XD-series infiltrator droid]], to [[EXD-9's infiltration of Chopper Base|infiltrate]] the rebel base on [[Atollon]].<ref name="Warhead" />
